inlines.v: LEISURE, noun lezh'ur or lee'zhur. 1. Freedom from occupation or business; vacant time; time free from employment. The desire of leisure is much more natural than of business and care. I shall leave with him that rebuke to be considered at his leisure 2. Convenience of time. He sigh'd, and had no leisure more to say. [Not used.]
